 CHICAGO, Ill. — Orlando City SC's lineup is live ahead of the Lions' midweek match on the road as they face the Chicago Fire.
 Zakaria Taifi and Luís Otávio are the two changes to the starting lineup for the Lions from last weekend as they replace Wilder Cartagena and Eduard Atuesta, the latter of whom is suspended due to yellow card accumulation. Cartagena is available off the bench.
 Joining him on the bench is Tiago, who missed out last match due to illness. He replaces Harvey Sarajian in the team sheet.
 Check out the rest of Orlando's lineup and bench for when the team takes the pitch at 8:30 p.m. ET on Apple TV .
 Orlando City lineup: Maxime Crépeau, Zakaria Taifi, David Brekalo, Iago, Vinicius Nogueira, Justin Ellis, Luís Otávio, Braian Ojeda, Iván Angulo, Martín Ojeda (c), Antoine Griezmann
 Substitutions: Javier Otero, Wilder Cartagena, Daryl Dike, Joran Gerbet, Adrián Marín, Nolan Miller, Marco Pašalić, Bernardo Rhein, Tiago
